steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Tubes
steps.instruction: Set up the heat block and label the reaction tubes.

substeps.instruction: Turn on heat block and set to 37ºC
Label clean 0.5mL microcentrifuge tubes with SampleID on the lid using a fine point Sharpie

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Retrieve and mix the enzyme and buffer.

substeps.instruction: Remove one aliquot each of stock XhoI enzyme and rCutSmart Buffer from the freezer
Spin down in mini spinner, if necessary

steps.title: Prepare XhoI Working Solution
steps.instruction: Combine buffer and enzyme in a 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Combine 62µL rCutSmart Buffer and 62µL stock XhoI enzyme

steps.title: Assemble Digestion Reactions
steps.instruction: Add the working solution and DNA samples to the labeled tubes.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 1µL XhoI working solution into the bottom of each labeled 0.5mL microcentrifuge tube
Transfer 5µL PocHIS amplicons to each 0.5mL tube, ensuring the correct sample is added to the correct tube

steps.title: Mix and Spin Samples
steps.instruction: Ensure the reaction components are thoroughly mixed.

substeps.instruction: Flick each tube gently to mix
Spin down tubes in mini spinner

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at the specified temperatures and durations.

substeps.instruction: Incubate all tubes at 37ºC for 60 minutes
Incubate all tubes at 65ºC for 20 minutes

steps.title: Store or Analyze Digests
steps.instruction: Process the digested samples immediately or store them.

substeps.instruction: Visualize digests immediately on gel if possible
